reporting-org.narrative: DiXi Group is a Ukrainian think tank that has been working in the energy sector since 2008. Our vision is that Ukraine needs to continue energy market reforms, which should promote competition and strengthen the role of consumers, as well as deeper integration with the EU energy market to guarantee security in the region. Ultimately, the policy should include a transition to clean and green technologies for energy production, transformation, transmission and consumption. DiXi Group sees itself as a driver of these changes and a safeguard against a return to old and corrupt practices. Our mission is to introduce the latest solutions and fair rules for affordable, high-quality and clean energy. Goals of the organisation: * Modernising Ukraine’s energy sector * Ukraine’s membership in the EU Key areas of our activities include: ANALYTICS: data research and analysis to make reasonable decisions ADVOCACY: approval of new governance standards in energy policy TRAINING: dissemination of knowledge and best practices in new markets CONSULTING: provision of useful information for governments and investors Our website: https://dixigroup.org/en/home-en/ Our annual report (2022): https://dixigroup.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/annual-report-dixi-group-en.pdf Our Strategic Plan (2023-2028): https://dixigroup.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/strategichnyj-plan-diksi-23-28-angl.pdf
